neighbours.label: 'as an'/'as a' introducing an illustrative example or role ('As an example', として, в качестве)
fire: As an example, take a bridge that must carry both trains and cars.
Consider, as an illustration, a shop that sells only one kind of bread.
As an example of this effect, the paper describes a small lake in Finland.
To give one example, a single tree can host hundreds of insect species.
As an example, suppose the input list contains only negative numbers.
The report uses the town of Ely as an example of successful flood planning.
As an illustration, imagine a library where every book is shelved by colour.
Take, as an example, a recipe that calls for two eggs and a cup of milk.
quiet: As a result, the bridge must carry both trains and cars.
Consider, as usual, the shop that sells only one kind of bread.
As a rule, the paper ignores small lakes in Finland.
To be honest, a single tree can host hundreds of insect species.
As soon as the input list contains only negative numbers, the loop stops.
The report praises the town of Ely for its successful flood planning.
As always, the library shelves every book by colour.
Take a recipe that calls for two eggs and a cup of milk and double it.

notes: Card: として x9 and в качестве x5 (both 'as, in the role of'), 'As an example' x2-3. Probe: 'As an example' 0.62, 'as a gift' 0.09, comparative 'as wide as' 0.02. So mostly the example sense. Near misses use other 'As a/an' set phrases.
